title: Abort-safe streaming publication
summary: webdav.streaming/0.1 provides a host-neutral upload session with bounded chunks, backpressure, staging, abort cleanup and explicit commit. Publication occurs only after exact-length and SHA-256 verification.
invariants: WebDavStreamingUploadSession accepts no chunk larger than nextMaximum().
Staged bytes are flushed but remain unpublished until commit.
Abort removes local staging and leaves no namespace entry.
Commit verifies expected bytes, physical stage size and streamed SHA-256 before StorageRef/catalogue/namespace publication.
The contract does not pretend HttpRequest~body is a stream.
